notes.title: Final update!
notes.notes:
This will be the final update for Project Exo!

With it comes a large amount of audio added so the game doesn't sound so dead anymore.

A lot of bug fixes and a few tweaks.

notes.title: Cosmetic Update!
notes.notes:
[b][/b] Cosmetic Update is here!

Coming with the new cosmetic update is 28 unique customizing options for your rocket launcher, rockets, trails and explosions. Everything from shooting phoenixes to black whole explosions to shuriken rocket trails.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42818870/8a2e5bc4eb452030c76a8a090fda85b46e523672.png[/img]


Every level will prove a challenge for you to unlock cosmetics. The more cups you can find and the better your time on levels the more cosmetic options you will unlock.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42818870/bc3a26eaeb51eb85f70dfdca62d39c2c87c14383.png[/img]
